caseParticipants.heading: Participants
caseParticipants.grantsNothing: Taking part lists the change on a person's My work and notifies them. It grants no access. The teams here are the assessment's contributors.
caseParticipants.alreadyParticipant: {name} already takes part in this case.
caseParticipants.cannotRead: {name}'s roles cannot open cases, so adding them would tell them nothing.
caseParticipants.tooMany: This case already has as many participants as it may. Remove one before adding another.
caseParticipants.closed: This case is closed, so its participants no longer change.
caseParticipants.contributorTeamsHint: Each team is added or removed on its own and shows under Participants.
